CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.zeyds_broadcast_ride_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform realtime.broadcast_changes(
    'ride:' || coalesce(new.id, old.id)::text,
    tg_op,
    tg_op,
    tg_table_name,
    tg_table_schema,
    new,
    old
  );
  return null;
end;
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.zeyds_driver_for_user(user_uuid uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select d.id
  from public.ride_drivers d
  join public.providers p on p.id = d.provider_id
  where p.auth_user_id = user_uuid
  limit 1;
$function$
;
